falsifier_statement: qmirror.cscs.run(n_pairs=3, n_shots=1024, n_trials=30) returns min(S_per_pair_mean) >= 2.7 AND W_mean >= 2.7 AND indep_pvalue_mean >= 0.05
substrate: Aer state-vector (6 qubits = 3 Bell pairs) + numpy_native fallback path
circuit: per pair k in {0,1,2}: H(2k) -> CX(2k, 2k+1) -> Ry(-theta_a, 2k) -> Ry(-theta_b, 2k+1); single 6-qubit Aer job per CHSH setting
S_formula: S_pair = E_ab + E_abp + E_apb - E_apbp  (canonical, all-positive E_ab/E_abp/E_apb and negative E_apbp on the (0, pi/2, pi/4, -pi/4) angle set with Ry(-theta) measurement-basis rotations)
violation_sigma_W_above_classical: W_mean above classical 2.0 by ~30 sigma at n_trials=30 (W_std=0.028)
ssot_components_overridden: compute_S (replaced with canonical formula; see caveat #3)
raw9_disclosure: cscs_runner.py is the THIRD .py file under qmirror standalone modules (after aer_runner.py and ghz_mermin_runner.py); hexa-strict module is cscs.hexa
raw15_compliance: no personal paths in .hexa or .py module bodies; bridge resolved via NEXUS_QMIRROR_BRIDGE_PATH env, CHSH_CIRCUITS_SSOT env, or HOME-relative fallback
raw10_caveats: Noiseless Aer state-vector reproduces near-Tsirelson per pair S~2.82 with shot-noise std ~0.04 at 1024 shots (binomial expectation sqrt((1-0.5)/1024)*4 sigma per S ~ 0.06; observed slightly tighter due to anti-correlated correlator pairs).  Real hardware (IBM Heron / IonQ / Rigetti) would exhibit two compounding decays: (a) per-pair single-Bell fidelity loss F_pair < 1 dropping S to ~2.3-2.5, (b) chained-register decoherence accumulating across 6 qubits in a single circuit (longer transpiled depth + cross-qubit crosstalk).  Optional $25 IBM Heron 2-pair anchor (per spec §2 axis 5) was DECLINED for this $0 default closure path.

CSCS chain construction here is 'sequential within one statevector' (3 Bell pairs in a single 6-qubit register, single Aer job per setting).  This is the entanglement-isolation form of chained CHSH (each pair is independent of the others by construction; no inter-pair CX).  An alternative 'temporal-sequential' form (3 Bell pairs prepared and measured back-to-back on the same 2 qubits with reset between) would test PRNG/state-reset independence rather than register-isolation independence; that variant is OUT OF SCOPE for cond.13 (a candidate for a future qmirror 3.0 axis).

S formula deviation from chsh_circuits.py SSOT compute_S: the SSOT defines S = E_ab - E_abp + E_apb + E_apbp (per its docstring and the sign empirically observed on cond.3 ibm_fez Heron r2 hardware where E_abp came out NEGATIVE).  On a noiseless Aer simulator with the canonical SSOT angle set (a=0, a'=pi/2, b=pi/4, b'=-pi/4) and Ry(-theta) recipe, all of E_ab, E_abp, E_apb are POSITIVE (~+0.71) while E_apbp is NEGATIVE (~-0.71), so the SSOT formula yields S~0 (cancellation) instead of saturating Tsirelson.  cscs_runner.py uses S = E_ab + E_abp + E_apb - E_apbp (canonical CHSH sign convention) which gives S~+2.83 on Aer.  This is a documented SSOT formula bug on the noiseless backend that should be addressed by a chsh_circuits.py SSOT amendment in a sister cycle (the SSOT works only for the specific cond.3 hardware sign pattern, not for clean Aer simulation).  All other SSOT components (SETTINGS, make_bell_chsh, correlator) are used unchanged.

Independence p-value reports the MIN over 4 settings * (n_pairs-1)=2 adjacent-pair conditional chi-squared tests = 8 tests per trial * 30 trials = 240 tests total.  Under the true null (independent Bell pairs), the expected MIN of 8 uniform p-values per trial is ~1/9 = 0.111; observed indep_pvalue_mean=0.112 matches this exactly, confirming the chained register imposes no detectable cross-pair dependence.  However, indep_pvalue_min=0.00026 (a single unlucky trial with 240 total chi-squared tests) is BELOW 0.05 — this is statistically expected under the null (with 240 uniform draws, the expected minimum is ~1/241=0.0042), NOT a genuine independence failure.  Cross-doc readers must interpret indep_pvalue_min as a multiple-testing artifact, not a scientific failure mode; only indep_pvalue_mean is the falsifier-bearing statistic per F-QM-2-CSCS-13.
